subtitle: Accounting & business management
welcome: A clear start to every day.
intro: Invoices, purchases and business records, together in one place.
notice: Sales, purchases, supplier payments and customer balances are available. Automatic synchronization, reports and exports are still pending.
catalogDetail: Products, customers, suppliers and payment methods.
invoiceDetail: Weight, amount, pieces and anonymous spice containers in one invoice.

auth.loginIntro: Sign in to your Alanan workspace.
auth.setupHelp: Need access? Ask your system administrator to set up your account.
auth.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

master.discardConfirm: Discard this unsaved draft… This cannot be undone.
master.title: Business records
master.name: Name
master.search: Search by name, code or phone
master.draftRestored: Your unsaved draft was restored. Review it before saving.
master.draftWarning: This browser could not store the draft. Keep this form open until the record is saved.

purchase.draftNotice: Draft saved on this device. The final invoice number is assigned when the server accepts it.
purchase.pendingRetry: This purchase was submitted, but confirmation may be missing. Its contents are locked so retrying cannot create a duplicate. Retry when connected.
purchase.storageError: The browser could not preserve this draft. Keep this page open and enable local storage before saving or refreshing.
purchase.approximateStock: Calculated stock is an estimate, not a guarantee of physical stock. Anonymous container sales do not deduct a specific spice.
purchase.closeBeforeUpdate: Finish or close the open form before updating the app.

errors.PURCHASE_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Select a supplier and a product for every item.
errors.SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE: This supplier is missing or inactive. Select an active supplier.
errors.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: An item is missing or inactive. Select active products.
errors.PAYMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: The payment method is inactive or no default is available. Choose an active method.
errors.WHOLE_PIECES_REQUIRED: Piece products must have a whole-number quantity.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: Paid now cannot exceed the invoice total.
errors.PURCHASE_AMOUNT_INVALID: Each line must round to at least 0.01 ₪, and amounts must fit the supported range.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request was already used with different details. Review saved invoices before taking further action.
errors.WAC_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Stock or its previous cost needs review before this purchase can update weighted average cost.
errors.PRODUCT_UNIT_LOCKED: This product has transaction history. Its tracking unit cannot be changed.
errors.EDIT_CONFLICT: This record changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Copy any changes you need, then discard the draft and reopen the latest record.
errors.CUSTOMER_PHONE_EXISTS: This phone belongs to another customer. Select the existing customer or change the phone.
errors.DUPLICATE_RECORD: This code or name is already in use. Use a different value.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: Enter a phone number with 6–20 digits; spaces, dashes and parentheses are allowed.
errors.INVALID_TRACKING_TYPE: Spices use kilograms and honey uses pieces.
errors.WALK_IN_PROTECTED: The default walk-in customer cannot be changed.
errors.DEFAULT_MUST_BE_ACTIVE: The default payment method must remain active.
errors.DEFAULT_REQUIRED: Choose another default payment method before removing this default.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is inactive.
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait five minutes before trying again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to access this page.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.INVALID_FIELD: Enter a valid value for this field.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: The server could not complete this request. Your entries are still here; try again shortly.
errors.DUPLICATE_ALLOCATION: An invoice can only be allocated once per payment.
errors.ALLOCATION_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Invoice allocations must equal the payment amount.
errors.ALLOCATION_INVOICE_UNAVAILABLE: An invoice is unavailable or belongs to a different account.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING: The allocation exceeds the invoice’s outstanding amount.
errors.AUTO_ALLOCATION_ITEMS_NOT_ALLOWED: Automatic allocation must not include manually selected invoices.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING: The payment exceeds the outstanding balance.
errors.CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE: This customer is missing or inactive. Select an active customer.
errors.CONTAINER_UNAVAILABLE: This container type is missing or inactive.
errors.SALE_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Select one product or one container type for each line.
errors.SALE_MODE_INVALID: The selling mode does not match this item's unit.
errors.SALE_INPUT_INVALID: Enter either a quantity or a requested amount for the selected mode.
errors.SALE_AMOUNT_INVALID: Amounts are outside the supported range, or the quantity rounds to zero.
errors.WALK_IN_MUST_PAY_FULL: Walk-in sales must be fully paid. Select a named customer for an unpaid balance.

payments.autoHelp: The full payment is allocated to the oldest unpaid invoices first. It cannot exceed this supplier’s outstanding balance.
payments.manualHelp: Enter the amount to pay against each invoice. Allocations must equal the payment amount. Changing supplier clears selected allocations.
payments.draftNotice: Payment draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; drafts are not sent automatically.
payments.pendingRetry: Confirmation may be missing. This payment is locked; retry the same request when connected to avoid duplicates.

sales.draftNotice: Draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; drafts are not sent automatically.
sales.pendingRetry: This sale was submitted, but confirmation may be missing. Its contents are locked. Retry the same sale when connected to avoid duplicates.
sales.negativeStock: This sale left calculated stock below zero. Review physical stock; the sale was saved and the warning was recorded.
sales.walkInHelp: Leave the customer blank for a walk-in sale. Walk-in sales must be fully paid. Select a named customer to record an unpaid balance.
sales.containerHelp: Records container revenue only. No specific spice is selected or deducted; cost remains unknown.

customerPayments.autoHelp: The full payment is allocated to the oldest unpaid sales first. It cannot exceed this customer's outstanding balance.
customerPayments.manualHelp: Enter an amount for each sale. Allocations must equal the payment. Changing customer clears selected allocations.
customerPayments.draftNotice: Payment draft saved on this device. Saving requires a connection; drafts are not sent automatically.
customerPayments.pendingRetry: Confirmation may be missing. This payment is locked; retry the same request when connected to avoid duplicates.
